instruction: Write a complete XDP/eBPF C program that drops IPv4 fragmented packets (where fragment offset > 0 or MF flag is set in ip->frag_off), passing unfragmented traffic.
requirements: Perform strict Ethernet header bounds checking
Verify IPv4 header bounds and protocol type
Apply accurate filtering logic and return valid XDP action

tests.name: fragment_mf_drop
tests.description: IPv4 packet with MF (More Fragments) bit set should be dropped

tests.name: fragment_offset_drop
tests.description: IPv4 packet with fragment offset 100 should be dropped
